content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to individual buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Different business: develops and sells finished lots to homebuilders (B2B), not homes sold to individual buyers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with in-house mortgage financing."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Same business: builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with mortgage, title and insurance services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Different business: an insurance underwriter for title, mortgage guaranty and commercial lines, not a homebuilder."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Different business: primarily life insurance and cemetery/mortuary services, with mortgages as a side line rather than home construction."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Different business: title insurance underwriter and real estate data/software provider, not a builder selling homes."}]}
